candidates.caption: Inside a small box placed inside Kha’s case and scattered over its base, alongside needles and kohl containers, Schiaparelli found a number of smooth pebbles of various colors. Since they could not be there by accident, the archaeologist hypothesized that they constituted a small collection of minerals which Kha had collected as rare and curious objects.
